Summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS building an in-app AI assistant + document search for product teams. Evaluating Redwood Hosted API initially; clear interest in moving to Dedicated once throughput and unit economics justify a commit. Primary drivers: consistent latency for interactive assistant, predictable token/unit cost, and corporate security controls (SSO, SOC2, KMS).

Recent timeline: 
- 2026-02-18: Intro discovery call (Taylor + Diego) — walked through Redwood API features, model catalog, and routing policies. Client: "we need sub-200ms 95th perc latency for quick UI responses".
- 2026-02-25: Hosted API demo (feature chat + embeddings) — demo recording: ff_9a7b6c_costworkshop_20260302.
- 2026-03-01: POC kickoff (hosted) — ingest sample product docs (~120k tokens), baseline metrics captured (avg response latency 260ms, 95p 420ms on p99 spikes), token consumption profile exported.
- 2026-03-02: Cost optimization workshop (initial) with Redwood Solutions — focused on batching strategy (micro-batching for UI vs bulk for nightly reindex), KV/prefix caching for common prompts, and quantization profile tradeoffs. Action: Redwood to produce unit economics models.

Technical requirements / constraints: 
- Workloads: interactive chat + multi-doc retrieval + reranking. Peak interactive QPS target: 35-45 reqs/s (concurrent users ~600), expected token mix: 20% long contexts (>2k tokens) for in-app transcripts, 80% short queries.
- Latency SLOs: 95th <= 250ms (chat), p99 as low as possible for UX. Throughput target for rerank jobs: 1500 requests/hour in batch windows.
- Cost sensitivity: aiming to reduce per-1M-token bill by 40% vs current hosted run; want clear tradeoffs between batching/caching and model quality.
- Model preferences: open model family (Llama-variant, LLM-optimized encoders) + evaluation of quantized variants for Dedicated. Need fallback routing for capacity constraints.
- Security/compliance: SSO/SAML, SOC2 attestation required, customer-managed KMS for Dedicated/VPC, audit logging retention 13 months, data residency in US only.

POC scope & success criteria: 
- Proof hosted API can meet 95th latency goal with batching and KV cache applied for common prompts.
- Quantization profile test (int8 / 4-bit) on representative shard of embeddings and chat model: maintain >=95% of baseline semantic similarity on eval set.
- Unit economics model demonstrating Dedicated commit ROI within 6 months at forecasted usage.
